Namma Metro Pink Line Undergoes Safety Inspection

The Commissioner of Metro Rail Safety (CMRS) has completed a three-day safety inspection of the elevated Pink Line section of Namma Metro, located on Bannerghatta Road in Bengaluru. The inspection period concluded after three days.
